title.narrative: Yemen Continuous Learning and Evaluation Activity (YCLE)

description.narrative: (Yemen): The Yemen Continuous Learning and Evaluation activity (YCLE) is USAID/Yemen's monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) contract, providing a range of third-party monitoring, evaluation, and other analytical services across the portfolio. With FY 2024 funds, YCLE will conduct third party monitoring of mission activities, contextual monitoring (as needed), and other analytical services needed to support the Mission's implementation and oversight of activity implementation. YCLE will utilize a "virtual tour" tool to monitor interventions in the more non-permissive geographical areas where there is USAID programming. Assessments and evaluations will be conducted as demand requires to support Mission learning needs. YCLE will also work to strengthen implementing partner activity monitoring and reporting and to support Mission MEL needs, including setting realistic but ambitious targets and reporting accurate results. ..
